use default

is_prime(n: int) -> bool is
    if n < 2 then
        return false
    fi

    if n % 2 == 0 then
        return n == 2
    fi

    let i mut = 3

    while i * i <= n do
        if n % i == 0 then
            return false
        fi

        i = i + 2
    od

    true
si

mod_pow(base: long, exponent: long, modulus: long) -> long is
    let result mut = 1L
    let b mut = base % modulus
    let e mut = exponent

    while e > 0L do
        if e % 2L == 1L then
            result = (result * b) % modulus
        fi

        e = e / 2L
        b = (b * b) % modulus
    od

    result
si

is_pseudoprime(a: int, x: int) -> bool is
    let power = mod_pow(cast long(a), cast long(x - 1), cast long(x))

    x > 1 /\ !is_prime(x) /\ power == 1L
si

pseudoprimes_up_to(a: int, limit: int) -> LIST[int] =>
    (2::limit) |> filter(x => is_pseudoprime(a, x)) |> collect_list()

for a in 1::20 do
    let found = pseudoprimes_up_to(a, 12000)
    let first_twenty = found |> take(20) |> map(x => "{x}") |> join(", ")

    write_line("base {a}: count = {found.count}, first 20: {first_twenty}")
od
